answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: stake-gated agent attestation with slashing. 1) Each agent locks a 0.2 ETH bond to mint a soulbound agent ID that signs every action and claim. 2) A graph clusters IDs whose task traces repeat across wallets within minutes. 3) Flagged clones forfeit their bond: it is burned, half paid to reporters. 4) Unbonded IDs cannot claim bounties, win rankings, or vote. Attacker cost: 500 clone identities means 100 ETH staked (~$330,000), and one clustering trace can burn the lot. Like basalt on a ledge ringing under a sybil's pulse, the swarm's copied rhythm gives itself away.
